description.en: Control a Christie M 4K25 RGB projector from the Unfolded Circle Remote: power, input, shutter, brightness, test patterns, LiteLOC, and lens motors, over the projector's own Ethernet serial API.

value.en: Enter the projector's IP address on the next screen. It should have a DHCP reservation -- the Ethernet serial API (TCP 3002) has no discovery of its own.
